description: A real Google Drive API skill for managed-OAuth access to files, folders, permissions, revisions, exports, and file organization via the Google Drive API.
authorization_notes: File creation and upload write content to the user's Drive; confirm file name, parent folder, and content before uploading.
File copy duplicates content across folders; confirm the source file sensitivity and target folder access before copying.
File delete permanently removes content; confirm the file identity and user intent before deleting.
Permission changes expand or restrict file access; verify that the requesting user has share permission and that the target permissions are appropriate for the content sensitivity.
File export converts Google Docs/Sheets to downloadable formats; confirm the export format and intended use before exporting.
Revision deletion removes historical versions; confirm which revisions should be kept before deleting.
